title: Mixed Event — Relaxing Tea Time — Episode6 How I Feel

meta.Event Outline: In the lead-up to White Day, Kanade begins thinking about how to express her gratitude for the Valentine's chocolate she received, as well as for all the help she's been given. As she's struggling to think of gifts, she learns that Ichika is having the same dilemma, and the two team up!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Let's see... Miku and the others should be...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Miku, Luka, perfect.
I was just hoping to ask you both a question.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, what would you like to ask us?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Has anything been on either of your minds lately?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Has anything been on our minds?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes, for example... Have your shoulders been sore? Maybe you're not sleeping as well as you usually do...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I'm not sure, but I don't think any of us have sore shoulders...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
I see...
Then, what are your favorite foods?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I'm happy with anything that you and the others bring over to SEKAI...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Are you in the middle of choosing gifts for White Day?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. Mostly based on the time of year. Also, you were being very suspicious.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Does this mean you're getting gifts for us?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Yes, I am.
I've been doing research by asking how everyone's been doing.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: So, I've been having a lot of trouble deciding what to get everyone. So, I've been asking these questions to find gifts that you'll all be genuinely happy to receive.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: So, do you already know what you're going to get everyone else?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes. I've asked them if anything has been on their minds lately...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But for example, I don't know what to get someone whose shoulders have been feeling a bit sore...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, what about a compress? Or a massage ball? They'd get to enjoy that for much longer...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Bath salts might also be nice.
A kind that helps improve blood circulation...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: That does sound nice. And warm...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: All of those seem like fun gift ideas.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes, I'd like to see how everyone reacts when they see that you gave them a compress.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, right... I guess that would be a bit odd...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Hehe. I'm just kidding.
But it seems like you've already given this quite a bit of thought. You're still undecided?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I've thought of a lot of ideas, but I haven't settled on any yet...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I was really hoping that asking everyone would help me decide.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Then, I think the rest comes down to how you feel.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: If you're still torn between a couple of options after giving these gifts as much thought as you have, on top of going through the trouble of learning how everyone's doing...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Then, all that's left is for you to go off gut feeling.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: How do you want them to feel, Kanade?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: How do I want them to feel...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I want to give them a chance to relax. To take a breath...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Thank you both very much.
I know what to do now.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I hope they enjoy what you get them.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I'm sorry for calling you at this hour, Hoshino, but I wanted to let you know that I've made my decision.
